checks.name: bronze_to_silver_count
checks.about: silver holds exactly as many events as bronze, both prefixes (no bronze key repeats, so the job's dedup removes nothing)

checks.name: bronze_to_silver_keys
checks.about: every bronze (transaction_id, event_type) is in silver, and nothing else is
checks.detail: 0 only in bronze, 0 only in silver

checks.name: silver_to_gold_transactions
checks.about: fct_transactions has one row per silver transaction, and no others
checks.detail: 0 missing from gold, 0 only in gold

checks.name: gold_status_matches_lifecycle
checks.about: fct_transactions.status is the transaction's last lifecycle state

checks.name: silver_duplicate_keys
checks.about: (transaction_id, event_type) is unique in silver (ADR 0017's MERGE key)

checks.name: lifecycle_created_authorized
checks.about: every transaction has exactly one created and one authorized event

checks.name: lifecycle_one_terminal
checks.about: every transaction ends in exactly one of settled or failed

checks.name: lifecycle_refunds
checks.about: a refund only follows a settle, at most once

checks.name: lifecycle_order
checks.about: created <= authorized <= settled/failed <= refunded in time
checks.detail: equal timestamps allowed (the clamp to now)

checks.name: silver_caught_up
checks.about: no bronze object is newer than the bronze watermark in silver's snapshots (the incremental job missed nothing)

checks.name: silver_key_nulls
checks.about: no nulls in the columns every event must carry

checks.name: amount_range_and_stability
checks.about: amount in [1.00, 999.99]; amount, currency, merchant, customer and token fixed per transaction

checks.name: roster
checks.about: at most 15 merchants and 75 customers, each id with one name

checks.name: masking
checks.about: emails @example.com; cards carry brand + 4-digit last4; other methods carry neither

checks.name: token_format
checks.about: tokens are tok_ + 16 letters, or the legacy tok_ + 16 hex from before #50

checks.name: token_digit_runs
checks.about: tokens with a 13+ digit run (a DLP scanner reads them as card numbers); legacy hex tokens only, accepted since #50 (bronze is append-only)
checks.detail: all in legacy hex tokens: true

checks.name: bulk_duplicate_keys
checks.about: (transaction_id, event_type) is unique across all generator runs
